# Files to Send for Review & Verification {#send}

```{r}
#| label: files-to-send
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| message: false
#| warning: false

if (exists("REPORTS_DIR") && dir.exists(REPORTS_DIR)) {
  .ext  <- if (file.exists(file.path(REPORTS_DIR, "mapping_key_CDX.xlsx"))) "xlsx" else "csv"
  .rows <- function(p) {
    if (!file.exists(p)) return(NA_integer_)
    if (grepl("\\.xlsx$", p)) nrow(suppressMessages(readxl::read_excel(p)))
    else nrow(suppressMessages(readr::read_csv(p, show_col_types = FALSE)))
  }
  .rp <- function(base, sub = "") file.path(REPORTS_DIR, sub, paste0(base, ".", .ext))

  cat("Outputs below go to the contributing groups for **review / verification**. ",
      "Reports are written as `.", .ext, "`",
      if (.ext == "xlsx") " — open in Excel; APOE genotypes stay text (no date conversion)."
      else " (install the `writexl` package for Excel-safe `.xlsx`).",
      " `sample_exclusion_report.csv` is **internal** (drives filtering) and is not sent.\n\n", sep = "")

  cat("### 1. Mapping keys — confirm the groupings\n\n")
  for (b in c("mapping_key_CDX", "mapping_key_Ancestry")) {
    p <- .rp(b); if (file.exists(p)) cat(sprintf("- `reports/%s.%s` (%d rows)\n", b, .ext, .rows(p)))
  }

  cat("\n### 2. Data-issue reports — correct & verify (⚠ = has flags, ✓ = clean)\n\n")
  .comb_xlsx <- file.path(REPORTS_DIR, "QC_error_report_combined.xlsx")
  .comb_csv  <- file.path(REPORTS_DIR, "QC_error_report_combined.csv")
  if (file.exists(.comb_xlsx)) {
    cat("- 📦 **`reports/QC_error_report_combined.xlsx`** — **all checks in ONE file** (SUMMARY sheet + one sheet per check). Send this single file; the per-issue files below are the same content split out.\n")
  } else if (file.exists(.comb_csv)) {
    cat("- 📦 **`reports/QC_error_report_combined.csv`** (+ `_summary.csv`) — all checks bundled into one file.\n")
  }
  .bys <- .rp("QC_error_report_by_sample")
  if (file.exists(.bys)) cat(sprintf("- 👤 **`reports/QC_error_report_by_sample.%s`** — one row per flagged sample (checks tripped, `n_issues`, `issues`) — %d sample(s)\n", .ext, .rows(.bys)))
  .esum <- .rp("QC_error_summary")
  if (file.exists(.esum)) cat(sprintf("- 📊 `reports/QC_error_summary.%s` — per-check flagged counts + batch totals\n", .ext))

  cat("\n**Error reports** — `reports/errors/`:\n")
  for (b in c("error_implausible_values", "error_unexpected_race_ethnicity",
              "error_APOE_integrity", "error_APOE_no_genotype", "error_clinical_consistency",
              "error_categorical_unexpected_levels", "error_duplicate_SAMPLE_ALIQUOT")) {
    n <- .rows(.rp(b, "errors"))
    if (!is.na(n)) cat(sprintf("- %s `reports/errors/%s.%s` — %d flagged\n", if (n > 0) "⚠" else "✓", b, .ext, n))
  }
  cat("\n**Missing-data reports** — `reports/missing_data/`:\n")
  for (b in c("missing_data_by_sample", "missing_data_summary")) {
    n <- .rows(.rp(b, "missing_data"))
    if (!is.na(n)) cat(sprintf("- %s `reports/missing_data/%s.%s` — %d row(s)\n", if (n > 0) "⚠" else "✓", b, .ext, n))
  }
  cat("\n**Duplicate / longitudinal sample reports** — `reports/duplicates/`:\n")
  for (b in c("Duplicate_review", "Longitudinal_review")) {
    n <- .rows(.rp(b, "duplicates"))
    if (!is.na(n)) cat(sprintf("- `reports/duplicates/%s.%s` — %d row(s)\n", b, .ext, n))
  }
  nn <- .rows(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "samples_not_in_metadata.csv"))
  if (!is.na(nn)) cat(sprintf("\n- %s `samples_not_in_metadata.csv` (output root) — %d NPQ samples lacking metadata\n",
                              if (nn > 0) "⚠" else "✓", nn))

  cat("\n### Supporting context (not action items)\n\n")
  cat(sprintf("- `reports/mapping_key_CDX.%s`, `reports/mapping_key_Ancestry.%s` — grouping keys (top level)\n", .ext, .ext))
  cat(sprintf("- `reports/check_CDX_vs_CaseControl_crosstab.%s` — CDX × Case_Control cross-tab\n", .ext))
  cat("\n*Internal, do not send:* `sample_exclusion_report.csv` (drives sample filtering).\n\n")
} else {
  cat("*No reports/ folder (covariates off).*\n\n")
}
```
